notes: Frontend-only mock app, so the backend lane was skipped as briefed. All checks ran against localhost:3000. Each browser check script passes as a flow run. Copy and behaviour mismatches against the REQ/JRN text are logged inside the scripts, so each criterion's status below reflects those findings.

checks.name: p13-ai-design-routing
checks.evidence: Tabs order OK. Ctrl+K 'business hours' lands on /ai/routing. Add/delete rule, hours, assignment and Save toast all work. Subtitle reads 'How the AI sounds and replies, the processes it automates, and who gets tickets it hands over.' (REQ-717 text differs). Drag reorder via Playwright dragTo did not change order (rule-0 still '250'). There is no keyboard or Move up/down reorder. Rule rows wrap onto 2 lines at 1280px.

checks.name: p13-workflows-list-templates
checks.evidence: STATS shows Active / Runs (7 days) / Completed only, with no 'Handed to a person %'. The ⋯ menu has Edit, Duplicate, Rename, Delete but no Test. Delete removes the row immediately with no confirm dialog (WorkflowsTab.tsx:94 calls remove directly). 4 templates show with step counts. Use template opens a Draft editor. New workflow offers blank or template. Rename via prompt works.

checks.name: p13-editor-list-view
checks.evidence: The trigger card shows 'Order status' and the phrases, but not quick reply 'Track my order' (present in mocks/workflows.ts). Branches for ot-3 render. Clicking + 'insert-ot-1-next' (between step 1 and 2) inserted the new step AFTER step 2, i.e. at the wrong position. The var picker on that step offers all variables, including ones set later (code, orders). Unsaved changes shows. A sidebar link shows 'Discard unsaved changes?', but the editor's own Back arrow (editor-back) navigates away with no prompt.

checks.name: p13-editor-canvas-sync
checks.evidence: Toggling List<->Canvas 5 times keeps 14 nodes, 16 edges, list cards and branches identical. Minimap and controls are present. A palette drop adds a node with the dashed warning outline and it is listed in Issues. Tidy up runs. Below 1024 the canvas toggle is hidden, but the text 'Canvas editing works on larger screens.' does not exist anywhere in src. Not verified (automation limit, 2 attempts each): connecting a handle by mouse drag, and Delete on a selected edge (edge click did not select it).

checks.name: p13-validation-turn-on
checks.evidence: Blank workflow plus an Ask step with no variable shows an Issues count with jump links. Turn on shows toast 'Fix N issues before turning this on.' After adding a variable, an End step and an intent, Issues clear and save, then the toggle goes to aria-checked=true. A duplicated Order tracking turned on shows workflows-duplicate-warning, but its copy differs from 'Two active workflows use this trigger. The first one in the list runs.' Note: the toggle only works after the first save.

checks.name: p13-test-order-tracking
checks.evidence: Happy path works: invalid email message, code email from support@goorin.com with subject 'Your Goorin verification code' and 6 digits, no orders shown before the code, 'You have 2 tries left.', lockout handed to Support, Resend invalidates the old code, the correct code shows #GB20398/#GB20211/#GB19790 and 'Anything else I can help with?', and no-orders shows Try another email / Talk to a person. Copy gaps: the second wrong code says '1 tries left' (should be '1 try left'), the price shows '$148' not '$148.00', and the button reads 'Track with UPS' not 'Track package'. The panel auto-starts, so typing the trigger phrase 'where is my order' first is treated as the email answer and gets 'That doesn't look like an email address.'

checks.name: p13-templates-widget-runtime
checks.evidence: Return ends with '#LR-5113 is started. We emailed your prepaid label.' but there is no label link (0 links). Address change: an unfulfilled order (imogen) gets 'Done. Your order will ship to ...'; a fulfilled one is handed to Support. Wholesale asks 4 questions and is handed to Wholesale. Size 58 gives 'Size M or L'. "I don't know" gives 'Please enter a number.' instead of a measuring tip. Widget: 'has my order shipped' runs the code flow and shows #GB20398. With Order tracking Off, it falls back to the AI reply 'I found order #GB20411...'.

checks.name: p13-phone-access
checks.evidence: axe: 0 serious/critical on /ai/voice, /ai/replies, /ai/workflows, /ai/workflows/wf-order-tracking, /ai/routing, /ai/testing. Tab reaches the editor's back, name, toggle, test, step open/menu and insert buttons. At 390: no overflow, no list targets under 44px, no canvas toggle, step settings slide up as a bottom sheet, Test is full screen with Chat/Inbox tabs.
